signature: [in script, on garland] « för S : Cath Kÿrka: / giord hos: Johan. G: Ahlgren: Stockholm: 1773”
remarks: Slide bow has guard but no saddle or ring; ferrules have star pattern; two plain tubular slide stays, lower one telescopic; garland silver-plated, saddle and ring in bell bow; saddle has pattern like Ahlgren in museum in Stockholm, 1 tubular bell stay, hinge, pin, eyelet; garland has Saxon-style rim wire, tooth pattern (stamped), ring with diamond pattern below teeth. Examined by the author 15 Aug 02.
